Profile

About Me

I am completing my Bachelor of Technology in Mechanical Engineering from Arya College of Engineering & I.T., Jaipur (2022 – April 2026), with a CGPA of 9.4 / 10 and First Rank in Semesters 7 and 8. My academic record is built on a genuine interest in automotive and production engineering — not just theory, but hands-on application.

At Bosch Security Training Academy, Bengaluru, I received structured training in diesel fuel injection systems — working directly on PE A-Type and VE mechanical pumps, RSV/RQV governors, injectors, and feed pumps. This gave me a deep, practical foundation in diesel powertrain diagnostics and engine system calibration.

At Agrawal Metal Works Pvt. Ltd., Bhiwadi, I worked on an active production floor — covering metal forming, machining, component assembly, quality control inspection, and shop-floor safety. This experience grounded my understanding of real-world manufacturing workflows and production engineering.

My engineering projects span automotive system design (Four-Wheel Steering + Regenerative Braking), IoT-integrated precision farming (selected for SIH-2025), and vehicle modification — all reflecting a systems-thinking approach and prototype mindset. I am actively seeking roles in powertrain, production, chassis, or vehicle system design.

🎯 Core Interest Areas

Automotive powertrain systems, diesel engine components, production engineering, vehicle dynamics, and sustainable mobility solutions.

⚙️ Technical Strengths

CAD modelling (Fusion 360, AutoCAD), hands-on fabrication and assembly, four-wheel steering design, fuel system diagnostics, and IoT-integrated mechanical systems.

🏭 Industry Exposure

Production floor at Agrawal Metal Works and diesel powertrain training at Bosch — covering manufacturing processes, QC protocols, and precision mechanical testing.

📍 Availability

Available for full-time roles from April / May 2026. Based in New Delhi; open to relocation across India. Immediate joining possible post-graduation.
